name: Olivia, Mobilized for War — "put a +1/+1 counter on that creature, it gains haste until end of turn, and it becomes a Vampire in addition to its other types"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Fired, haste was a global effect that reached nothing and the Vampire type was dropped: the counter, the haste and the type are one comma list. With the "you may discard a card" toggle at Yes, the creature picked gains haste and is a Bear Vampire; Olivia herself is unchanged.
